rationale: COIN has gapped down ~7.7% on a broad risk-off session (SPY -1.18%, VIXY +6.3%) and is trading near the session low with extreme 1-minute candle ranges (nearly $3-4 per bar) and only 8.2% position in today's range, indicating unresolved directional pressure. Price is well below both VWAP ($145.53) and the 9-EMA ($147.86), suggesting continued downside momentum, but the proximity to the session low and high relative volume (3.93x) create whipsaw risk in both directions. With two working orders already committed and no clear stabilization or reversal signal, the risk/reward does not justify adding a third position in this chaotic early-session environment.
